name: foundry-connect
description: Marketplace for the Foundry Connect plugin, which runs the Foundry Connect pipeline lifecycle from Claude over the Foundry Connect remote MCP server.

plugins.name: foundry-connect
plugins.description: Run the Foundry Connect pipeline lifecycle from Claude: explore runs, access data, share results, author processes, build or extend pipelines, and duplicate and execute runs and apps.

plugins.name: foundry-connect-channel
plugins.description: Optional companion to foundry-connect: a local channel that links a Claude Code terminal session to the Foundry Connect chat drawer.
